messages:
emily: Canary in ap-northeast failed right after helm promote. Pods crash with config validation errors.
jared: logs?
emily: init container: `config-validator: invalid value for values.featureFlags.enableX: expected boolean, got string`
nina: we merged a chart PR that changed the flag name and type (string->boolean) but a values file in the pipeline still has the old string value.
ci-bot: Promotion run 3642000000 shows global values overlay applied, but regional overrides directory includes an old YAML for ap-northeast that wasn't regenerated.
emily: deploy-bot marked canary unhealthy and paused promotion. @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary 3642000000-ap-northeast paused due to CrashLoopBackOff. Action: hold and notify release-ops.
release-ops: options: rollback chart in region, apply a regional values override to coerce the type, or patch the validator to accept coercible values. Change window ~30m.
jared: rollback loses new routing fixes. Patch to validator is risky mid-window. Best is regional override: set `featureFlags.enableX=false` (boolean) in an overrides file and promote just for ap-northeast.
nina: agree. We'll annotate release so it's clear this is a temporary regional override. Add `release-annotation: regional-values-coerce-apne` and `temp-unpin-by=3642003600`.
emily: I'll queue it. Command I'm using: `deploy-bot promote --env ap-northeast --overrides overrides/apne-featureflag-bool.yaml --annotate "regional-values-coerce-apne"`
deploy-bot: Queued job 3642000012 by emily. Running preflight -> apply overrides -> helm upgrade.
ci-bot: Preflight log: overrides validated; upgraded release with override; waiting for pods.
emily: pods are booting, init container passes now. Starting smoke tests.
ci-bot: smoke tests passed. Canary healthy with override. :thumbsup:
release-ops: decision recorded: apply regional override to fix boolean mismatch, no rollback. Follow-up actions: 1) update release notes with Known Issue entry describing regional override and unpin ETA; 2) add gating step in promotion pipeline to validate regional overrides against chart schema; 3) add PR checklist item to regenerate regional overrides when changing values schema.
jared: I'll push the release note to /docs/release-drafts/3642.md and file a small pipeline PR to add schema validation for overrides.
nina: Also adding a lint rule in the chart repo to fail PRs that change a value type without a migration note and a 'regenerate-overrides' label.
emily: leaving release annotation `regional-values-coerce-apne` and metadata `temp-unpin-eta=3642003600`. Closing thread after unpin.
